summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are staying at a hotel in Yamamoto mountains, Nagano Prefecture, where they meet the twins from the case of the cursed mask as workers and Kogoro watches Yoko Okino's completed TV drama in the lobby. Later, an actress comes and causes trouble. The next day, she is found hanged in her room. In Greek Mythology, Icarus, who received wings, forgot his father's warning that he shouldn't fly too high, and flew higher and higher. He believed he could fly to the sun. But Icarus' wings couldn't bear the heat when he got too close to the sun. After his wings burned, Icarus fell from the sky right to the ground.
